patches_comment: The vitest runner is patched locally, see patches/@stryker-mutator+vitest-runner+10.0.0.patch, applied by the prepare script. Version 10.0.0 builds the per mutant testNamePattern by joining the describe chain with a single space, while vitest 5 matches that pattern against the chain joined with ' > '. Unpatched, every non static mutant runs zero tests and is reported as Survived. Upstream issue: https://github.com/stryker-mutator/stryker-js/issues/6210
tempDirName_comment: The sandbox must not live in a dot directory. Rule matching goes through picomatch, whose ** does not cross a segment starting with a dot, so a sandbox under .stryker-tmp silently changes what the fixture integration test sees.
disableTypeChecks_comment: Stryker adds a @ts-nocheck banner to every sandbox file by default. That rewrites tests/fixtures/basic-project and shifts the line numbers the fixture integration test asserts on. Vitest transpiles without type checking, so the banner is not needed here.
timeoutMS_comment: A static mutant reruns the whole suite serially, because the runner forces maxWorkers 1 for static mutants. Nearly all of that cost is module loading, which enters the timeout formula as a flat overhead and not as a multiple of the test time, so timeoutFactor is the wrong knob to turn. With this value the budget is 1.5 x 742 + 30000 + 7690, about 38.8 s, against a serial suite that runs in about 8.4 s.
